Ask people who built wealth if they lived within their means.

Kevin Trudeau says they all answer the same way: no, of course not. They lived below their means on the way up.

He says most people do the opposite. They use credit cards and payment plans, then judge a purchase by whether the monthly payment fits.

Which approach sounds closer to how you think about spending?
